purpose: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-W4SV-FOLD-A-V1: Columns: the first-visit Solver answers of arm b-w4 (B), the twin t-twin (T) and the delivering arm a-agree (A), each rendered through the delivered row's deliver normaliser and projection (AT1 self-check) and scored ONCE as a complete column with slurp-slu-official-train (stage3_rollout_score.py --mode supply-variants), paired by row (sample_id), 10,000 draws, seed 20260928. THE NULL: T minus A on official pooled SLU-F1 and intent accuracy; its bar is |T - A delta| + the T - A CI95 half-width (the same law as the cross-flight in-chain A/A), never below the provisional floor 0.3163 pp SLU-F1 (the ROLL-AA anchor 0.735 pp at n = 200 scaled to n = 1,080, scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py). INSTRUMENT FAULT (no verdict): the T - A CI95 excludes zero on either metric. NOMINATED (the claim ceiling; Q6 ruling): the B - A official pooled SLU-F1 delta exceeds the bar AND its CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the B - A intent CI95 upper bound is not below zero (the guard: no measured intent loss). HARMFUL: the B - A CI95 upper bound below zero on either metric. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED (width). A nomination only sends the composed policy to a full-system read against an in-chain A/A; it is never an admission and never a system-level claim. Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings and the per-type exact TP/FP/FN of the 19 revised types, B vs A and T vs A.
